scope: Resolve PowerPoint Repair Errors Triggered by Multi-Chart Collisions, Shared Resource Overwrites, and Batch Insertion

testBed.rule: Read-only test harness; do NOT modify or add code to showcase/charts_operations.js

tasks.title: Fix Part Naming, Relationship ID Collisions, and Content Types for Multiple Charts
tasks.description: Fix the root cause where adding more than one chart corrupts the presentation: (1) Ensure each new chart part receives a strictly unique part name across both standard charts (/ppt/charts/chart1.xml, chart2.xml, ...) and Office 2016+ extended charts (/ppt/charts/chartEx1.xml, chartEx2.xml, ...), (2) Ensure each embedded Excel spreadsheet receives a unique part filename (/ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet1.xlsx, Worksheet2.xlsx, ...), (3) Allocate globally unique relationship IDs (rId) in both presentation-level and slide-level .rels files without overwriting prior chart relationships, (4) Register individual <Override> entries in [Content_Types].xml for all added chart parts and spreadsheets without deduplicating or dropping earlier entries.

tasks.title: Fix Shape ID, Non-Visual Properties, and Coordinate Transform Collisions in <p:spTree>
tasks.description: Ensure multiple chart graphic frames inserted on the same or sequential slides do not clash: (1) Allocate monotonically increasing unique <p:cNvPr id='...' name='...'> IDs across all slide shapes, (2) Prevent overlapping coordinate collisions by validating bounding transforms (<a:xfrm><a:off x='...' y=''/><a:ext cx='...' cy=''/></a:xfrm>), (3) Correctly append multiple <p:graphicFrame> elements to <p:spTree> sequentially without replacing earlier graphic frames or truncating group shapes.

tasks.title: Isolate Dual-Sync Embedded Excel Workbooks Across Concurrent Charts
tasks.description: Fix src/elements/charts/ChartWorkbookUpdater.js to decouple backing workbooks so multiple charts do not attempt to share or mutate the same /ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet1.xlsx: (1) Generate an isolated .xlsx archive in the Virtual File System for each chart instance, (2) Create an independent ppt/charts/_rels/chartN.xml.rels (or chartExN.xml.rels) targeting its dedicated workbook, (3) Ensure formula strings (<c:f> or <cx:f>) reference the correct isolated worksheet without inter-chart cell collisions.

tasks.title: End-to-End Validation with showcase/charts_operations.js and Zero-Repair Verification
tasks.description: Execute showcase/charts_operations.js in read-only mode to test batch chart additions. Verify through automated tests and PowerPoint presentation opening that all chart types added consecutively across slides or onto a single slide open cleanly with zero repair prompts or XML corruption warnings.
